description: regclass defaults retain OID identity across rename and enforce PostgreSQL drop dependencies
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_regclass_reference CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_regclass_renamed CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_regclass_target CASCADE;
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_regclass_target (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);

CREATE TABLE type_matrix_regclass_reference (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, target REGCLASS DEFAULT 'type_matrix_regclass_target'::REGCLASS, targets REGCLASS[] DEFAULT '{type_matrix_regclass_target}'::REGCLASS[]);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_regclass_target RENAME TO type_matrix_regclass_renamed;
SELECT target, targets FROM type_matrix_regclass_reference ORDER BY id;

SELECT target IS NULL AS scalar_default_removed, targets IS NOT NULL AS array_default_retained, targets[1]::TEXT <> 'type_matrix_regclass_renamed' AS dropped_name_unresolved FROM type_matrix_regclass_reference WHERE id = 3;
